blockers.detail: Custom-question div comboboxes did not expand on click (aria-expanded stayed false); focus + ArrowDown expanded them. Escape did NOT close keyboard-opened lists (they remained in DOM), so option reads must target ul#field-<n>-list specifically.
Phone country code and 'What state do you live in?' lists render no options until a query is typed. Not typed (read-only policy).

runtime_observations:
Random per-render name attributes (e.g. name=74TJQImfM-); ids are field- and shift between employers/renders. Bind by aria-labelledby span text or by preceding

prompt text.
has_value=true on the phone country combobox in a blank form is the pre-selected country code, not user data.

inferred.required_marker_inference: sibling * after the label span co-occurs with aria-required=true; custom radiogroups show aria-required=false even when employer likely expects an answer; treat unanswered radios as soft-required.
inferred.typeahead_inference: State and location typeaheads likely accept US state names; phone country list likely 'Country (+code)'. Unverified.
inferred.optional_fields_vary: LinkedIn/Website/Current company/Pronouns appear only when the employer enabled them (rp-03 lacked LinkedIn/Website/Pronouns).

provider_hint.for_jev:
Rippling ATS: single page at /apply?step=application. Labels are span#field-N-label via aria-labelledby; custom questions have NO label association — the prompt is the

immediately preceding the field container, and the control's aria-label is just 'Select'. Required = sibling '*' or aria-required. Custom answers are Yes/No comboboxes or radiogroups; salary is a 15-char text. EEO block (Gender/Race/Hispanic/Veteran) and SMS consent are voluntary and human-only. Stop at button 'Apply'.
escalate_to_writer_opus: cover letter file content if the user wants one generated (upload is human-gated)
any free-text custom question beyond salary/relationship detail

edge_cases: Two identical 'Apply now' buttons on the job page (top and bottom); semantic click by text is ambiguous, pick by ref/nth.
Keyboard-opened listboxes persist after Escape; multiple ul[role=listbox] can coexist in DOM, so read options by list id, not by 'first visible listbox'.
